bias.zh: 偏空 · 反弹收复 5 日和 10 日均线

read.en: MP Materials rose 9.1% on Oct 27 to $40.87, trading between $38.00 and $41.04. It is above the falling 5-day ($38.94) and 10-day ($39.44) averages and below the falling 30-day ($44.67), 100-day ($50.28) and 200-day ($55.59). MACD has been below its signal since Aug 31 and below zero, with the histogram almost at a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($41.78), and RSI is 42.
read.zh: MP Materials 10月27日上涨 9.1%，收于 $40.87，盘中区间 $38.00–41.04。股价位于下行的 5 日（$38.94）和 10 日均线（$39.44）上方，低于下行的 30 日（$44.67）、100 日（$50.28）和 200 日均线（$55.59）。MACD 自 8月31日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图几乎收窄至交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$41.78），RSI 为 42。

read.en: The rebound cleared the $37.8 and $39.6–40 resistances, now support. Resistance is $41.0–41.8 (Oct 27 high, SAR), then $42.5 (Oct 16 high) and $44.5–44.7 (Oct 1 low, 30-day). Support is $39.4–40, then $38–38.9 (Oct 27 low, 5-day) and $37.1 (52-week low). A close above $41.8 would flip the SAR and target $42.5–44.7; below $39.4, $38.

s.zh: 10日均线 $39.44 和 $40 整数关口，已突破

s.en: 5-day average $38.94; Oct 27 low $38.00; Oct 22 and Jul 29 lows ($37.57–37.81)
